title: Deployment of Riot Police at Jalan Tukang Westlite Dormitory on 13 October 2021
what_it_is: Deployment of Riot Police at Jalan Tukang Westlite Dormitory on 13 October 2021

sections.label: Police response at Westlite Dormitory
sections.summary: Police responded to a call at Jalan Tukang Westlite Dormitory on 13 October 2021, resolved the situation with MOM and dormitory staff, made no arrests, and noted SOC was activated twice in five years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: On 13 October 2021, the Police responded to a call for assistance at the Jalan Tukang Westlite Dormitory.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: Patrol officers from Jurong Police Division were dispatched to the dormitory.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: The officers from Jurong Police Division together with the dormitory staff and officers from MOM managed to resolve the situation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: While the Jurong Police Officers were engaged, they also assessed that it was necessary to have other Police units on standby, in the event the situation became violent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: However, these additional units were not needed to be deployed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: No arrests were made by the Police during the incident.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: The Police do not track the number of times that its contingency forces have been activated to respond to public order incidents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: As a reply to Ms He Ting Ru’s question on previous deployments to active situations in the last five years, officers from the Special Operations Command (SOC) were activated in response to public order incidents on two occasions: at the Singapore Boys' Home in September 2016 and September 2018.
